name: Group Header 128
definition: Provides the characteristics shared by all individual transactions included in the message.

MessageIdentification.name: Message Identification
MessageIdentification.definition: Point to point reference, as assigned by the instructing party, and sent to the next party in the chain to unambiguously identify the message.|Usage: The instructing party has to make sure that 'MessageIdentification' is unique per instructed party for a pre-agreed period.

CreationDateTime.name: Creation Date Time
CreationDateTime.definition: Date and time at which the message was created.

InitiatingParty.name: Initiating Party
InitiatingParty.definition: Party that initiates the status message.

ForwardingAgent.name: Forwarding Agent
ForwardingAgent.definition: Financial institution that receives the instruction from the initiating party and forwards it to the next agent in the payment chain.

DebtorAgent.name: Debtor Agent
DebtorAgent.definition: Financial institution servicing an account for the debtor.

CreditorAgent.name: Creditor Agent
CreditorAgent.definition: Financial institution servicing an account for the creditor.
